sloka: प्रमृज्य वदनं तस्य कपिराजस्य धीमतः ।अब्रवीत् कालसम्प्राप्तमसम्भ्रममिदं वचः ।। ६.४६.३७ ।।।।
transliteration: pramṛjya vadanaṁ tasya kapirājasya dhīmataḥ ।abravīt kālasamprāptamasambhramamidaṁ vacaḥ ।। 6.46.37 ।।।।

translations.english: "O king of monkeys! This is not the time for faint heartedness. Extreme attachment at this time will lead us to death."
